e: From scientific Latin Azhdarchidae (family name), ultimately from Persian اژدر (“mythological serpent”).
q: There are few creatures that embody the strangeness of the extinct quite like azhdarchids.
Azhdarchid pterosaurs, the largest-ever living flyers, bigger and lighter than Orville and Wilbur Wright's early aeroplanes, glided overhead.
